verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS platform that handles sensitive company and financial data and advertises AI-powered bookkeeping, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains nothing about AI training data use, opt-outs, or a related privacy policy, so the verdict is none.
